what: Colour layer: skin-tone tint + hair colour written to the preset; iris colour word feeds eye-part ranking by name
finding: installed female head skin albedo averages (128,110,102): photo/albedo > 1 on every channel, so a multiply-by-ratio tint always clamped to white. Replaced by a lookup on Skyrim's own skin-tone preset gradient (HumanFemaleSkinWhite01-10, HumanSkinDarkSkin05-10).
caveats: Estimates from one photo each (lighting, white balance, makeup). Photo-lightness to preset mapping is a calibration choice [U]. Multiply semantics inferred from preset values, not confirmed in game. Eye colour for light eyes in small photos is unreliable (p5 blue eyes read grey-brown). Eye parts are ranked by NAME only (about 21% of 1866 installed eye parts carry brown/blue/green in their EditorID).
